newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai interbank rate, baht ease in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Thai interbank rate, baht ease in late trade.

text.p: The Thai overnight interbank rate fell to 12.00-12.50 percent late on Tuesday from 13.00-14.00 percent in early trade on easier money supply, dealers said.
Dealers said the money supply eased following injections of funds into the system by Bank of Thailand since late last week after rumors that some finance firms had liquidity problems.
"The interbank rate was quoted around 12 percent in the afternoon. The market was reacting to central bank's injection of money into the market," said a dealer from Siam Commercial Bank.
The Bank of Thailand injected 49.4 billion baht into the market between September 5-9.
The baht also eased slightly against the dollar to 25.354-25.359 from 25.340-25.348 late on Monday, dealers said.
"There's more buying interest for the greenback than selling interest," said one dealer.
The one-month baht/dollar swap premium softened to 10.00/10.50 from 11.30/12.30 satangs this morning and 11.25/12.25 late Monday, dealers said.
The mid-rate was fixed at 25.34 to the dollar against 25.33 on Monday. -- Boonrith Rattanawaraporn
